XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure to start, engine fault warning lights and glow plugs active, gearbox stuck in gear.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | ELECTRONICS | CONTROL UNIT | MECHATRONICS | GEARBOX | AUTOMATIC | P0850 | P0607 | LIGHT UP | LIGHTED | LIGHTED | MIL | YELLOW | YELLOW | LOCK | SECOND | RATIO | GEARS | FLASHES | INTERMITTENT | FLASHING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability rating key

* low level : Reported by a car repairer; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with a 7-speed DSG7 gearbox (Volkswagen 0CW dual-clutch gearbox)

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit

  • Fault: The vehicle fails to start, with the starter motor not turning; at the same time, the gearbox remains permanently locked in one gear (second gear), with the engine fault light illuminated and the glow plug fault light flashing.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0850 (Gear selector switch input circuit, P-N position – Generic fault)
    • P0607 (Engine injection control unit, performance module – Internal fault)
  • Cause: Faulty automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit

• Action: Check the operation of the automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit and, if necessary, repair it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, an oil leak was detected on the automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit; following its replacement, the fault was permanently resolved.
    The component is accessible from beneath the engine; it is located in the engine compartment between the engine and the radiator, on the driver’s side, and is connected to the gearbox on the outside, near the radiator; the control unit can be accessed after removing a radiator coolant hose.
